$comment: Per-source collector settings. minAreaM2: collect only homes with at least this floor area (null = any). SUUMO, Nifty and RoomSpot apply it as the portal's own search filter, rounded down to the portal's nearest step; AtHome keeps its search conditions in the browser session, so its collector drops smaller rooms after reading each page. UR ignores it (one API sweep per city, and filtering would mark the skipped rooms gone). `--min-area N` on a collector or on `npm run refresh` overrides this for one run; `--min-area 0` turns it off.

availability.$comment: Which homes `npm run refresh` re-checks for still being on offer (the `availability` stage, `npm run check:availability -- --watch`). top: how many of the best-scoring homes to watch. criteria: what decides the best-scoring ones, as a recommendations API request (RECOMMENDATIONS_API.md: weights, filters, travel …); the dashboard keeps yours in the browser where a script cannot read them, so repeat them here (anything left out keeps its default; these are the dashboard weights recorded in REFRESH.md on 2026-11-01, with the walk-or-cycle settings of 2026-11-11: bicycle minutes, the private school and mosque scoring 0 at 20 minutes, and homes further than 20 minutes from either left out). staleDays: a home seen in a portal's results or confirmed still listed within this many days is not visited. pageLoads: ad pages one refresh may load for this; 0 turns the stage off, and `--availability-limit N` on `npm run refresh` overrides it for one run.
